name: SPI Solar Panel Installation NC
old_description: We have helped hundreds of North Carolina homeowners cut their energy bills and protect their homes with professional solar installations and roofing built to last. Certified experts, transparent pricing, and a guarantee that protects your investment for 25 years.
about:
Based in Charlotte, North Carolina, SPI Solar Panel Installation NC is a locally owned and operated solar and roofing contractor that has served homeowners across the state for more than ten years. The company was founded by a team of certified installers who recognized that many North Carolina residents were being approached by out-of-state firms that relied on subcontractors and offered little ongoing support.

The firm provides a full suite of residential energy services, including custom rooftop solar design and installation, solar panel repair, complete roof installation, repair and inspection, home battery storage, electric vehicle charger installation, solar-powered heat pumps, home insulation and sealing, and solar shading systems. All work is performed by the company’s own crews, with no subcontractors, and the company reports having installed systems for hundreds of homeowners, collectively generating over 25 million kilowatt-hours of clean energy annually.

Its customer base consists exclusively of residential property owners throughout North Carolina, from coastal regions to the mountains. The company tailors each project to the home’s specific energy usage, roof condition, and local utility requirements, and also assists with permitting and utility interconnection paperwork.

The founders started the business to address what they saw as a gap in the market: out-of-state solar and roofing companies making large promises, sending subcontractors, and disappearing after installation. SPI differentiates itself by using only certified local installers, offering transparent pricing, a 25-year performance guarantee, free home assessments, and dedicated aftercare support for the life of the system.
